stories.headline: How to Make $3000/Month On Clipping Videos With AI (Full Workflow)
stories.body: Higgsfield Katana integrates into Claude via MCP, allowing users to perform complex video editing—like style transfer, beat-matching to reference videos, and automated localization—using natural language prompts rather than timeline-based software.
stories.why: While a proprietary cloud-based tool, the workflow demonstrates a shift toward 'agentic editing' where an LLM manages sub-tasks like shot selection and asset generation. For a USD/Houdini pipeline, the takeaway is the use of MCP to bridge high-level intent (Claude) with specific processing nodes (Katana), which is a viable model for automating studio pipeline tools.

whats_transferable: Using reference videos as temporal and stylistic templates for AI-driven automated editing.
Prompt-based orchestration of video assets, including analysis of narrative hooks in long-form content.
Automated multi-language localization workflows that handle both translated audio and re-timed captions within a single pass.
